presentation.body: Skrzynka keeps multiple inboxes in one local service. It resolves mailbox credentials from Skarbiec, so secrets do not move into command lines or configuration files.
presentation.title: One place for every working inbox

presentation.body: Skrzynka stores mailbox and message metadata in a local SQLite database. Its status report reads that database and shows the schema, mailbox and message counts, polling interval, and whether Skarbiec is available.
presentation.title: Start by checking the local service

presentation.body: Run `skrzynka status`. A successfully rendered status report is the first real result: it proves the local database is ready and gives you the baseline before you connect and sync a mailbox. Then run `skrzynka onboarding` again to finish.
presentation.title: Produce your first status report
